call_points.text: No FY27 PAT or EBITDA guidance; management cited volatile prices and said only that operations should be better.
IPP generation for FY27 expected to beat last year's about 415 crore units.
Environmental clearance for the SKS expansion: TOR submission in about 3 months, then 6-8 months to final clearance.
Shahpur West coal mine to start by end-FY27; Bartunga Hill to open at end of next financial year.
The ₹110 Cr one-off added ₹162.64 Cr to revenue and about ₹18 Cr to other income; EBITDA effect is 25% of ₹110 Cr.
Ferro alloy margins may improve on softening raw material prices; steel prices seen stable.
Net debt-free on standalone and consolidated basis, with liquidity above ₹2,500 Cr as of 30 June 2026.
All ongoing expansion projects are funded through internal accruals; about ₹300 Cr being invested in a Vizag waste heat recovery plant.
Biggest execution risk named is regulatory approvals; management sees no material risk otherwise.
Company plans to double SKS Power capacity to 1,200 MW by FY30 following Supreme Court clearance.
Board approved expansion of Raipur iron ore pellet plant capacity from 9 lakh tons to 20 lakh tons with an outlay of ₹500 crores.
Annual capex for FY27 and FY28 is planned in the range of ₹500 crores to ₹700 crores, excluding the 600 MW SKS expansion.

operating_notes.text: Existing pellet capacity is 0.90 MnT running at 92% utilisation; a 1.10 MnT addition at about ₹500 Cr is planned over 30 months from start of work.
FY26 exceptional item of ₹10.24 Cr is a power cost incentive received in Q3 for earlier years.
Power segment FY26 result before interest and tax was ₹1,095.02 Cr against ₹536.55 Cr in FY25, helped by the SKS acquisition and 24.9 MW Rehar commissioning.
Energy segment contributed two-thirds of total EBITDA in FY26.
Achieved highest-ever annual production of Sponge Iron, Iron Ore Pellets, HB Wires and Coal in FY26.
Thermal power generation (ex captive) reached a record 4,155 million units in FY26.
Hydropower generation reached 661 million units in FY26, supported by Rehar project commissioning.
PPAs cover over 380 MW of 710 MW saleable power capacity, of which about 330 MW is SKS, at tariffs of ₹5-6 per unit.
600 MW thermal plant ran at 85.9% average PLF in Q1FY27; IPP generated about 415 crore units last year.
Mineral wool is running at 60-65% capacity and is not yet profitable; full capacity expected in 3-6 months.
Sarda Metals & Alloys approved incorporating a step-down WOS in Dubai with an initial investment up to ₹3 Cr for Middle East trading.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,253.57 Cr (+1.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹157.99 Cr (+45.9% YoY).
Sarda Energy reported Q4 FY26 PAT of ₹155 Cr (+53% YoY) and announced Supreme Court clearance for SKS Power resolution plan.
Manish Sethi, CFO, shared the Q4 & FY2026 results conference call recording link on 25 May 2026 via https://seml.co.in/Financials/Quartely_Results/2025-26/SEML%20Concall%20Recording%20Q4FY26.mp3.
Sarda Energy reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,258 Cr and PAT of ₹155 Cr, with FY26 revenue up 23% YoY to ₹5,928 Cr.
On its 3 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Sarda Energy reported total income of ₹1,717 Cr, EBITDA of ₹762 Cr and PAT of ₹478 Cr (including a ₹110 Cr one-off), and said it is now net debt-free.
Sarda Energy's subsidiary Sarda Metals & Alloys approved setting up a step-down WOS in Dubai for up to ₹3 Cr on 17 October 2026.
